ModbusCmd.Title: State Supply flow target temperature HC1
State Heatpump mode
ModbusCmd.HintText: 0=Auto 1=Cool 2=Dry 3=Fan 4=Heat 21=Cool Storage 24=Heat Storage

ModbusCmd.Title: Actual Hot water temperature
ModbusCmd.HintText: (50 + (IU[0..47] *50)) + 26 (50 + (IU[0..47] *50)) + 25 Hot water temperature Celsius value x 10

ModbusCmd.Title: State Hot water operation mode
ModbusCmd.HintText: 0=Eco 1=Standard 2=Power 3=Force (For the EHS only)

ModbusCmd.Title: State Switching valve
ModbusCmd.HintText: 0=Room heating or cooling 1=Hot water preparation

ModbusCmd.Title: State Backup Heater
ModbusCmd.HintText: 0=Backup Heater operation OFF 1=Backup Heater step 1 operation ON 2=Backup Heater step 2 operation ON

ModbusCmd.Title: State Booster Heater
ModbusCmd.HintText: 0=Booster Heater operation OFF 1=Booster Heater operation ON

ModbusCmd.Title: State Supply flow target temperature HC2
Set Heatpump mode
ModbusCmd.HintText: 0=Auto 1=Cool 2=Dry 3=Fan 4=Heat 21=Cool Storage 24=Heat Storage

ModbusCmd.Title: Set Target Supply Flow target temperature HC1
ModbusCmd.HintText: Heating= 15°C to 65°C Cooling= 5°C to 25°C (attention for dew point!)

ModbusCmd.Title: Set Hot water operation mode
ModbusCmd.HintText: 0=Eco 1=Standart 2=Power 3=Force (for the EHS only)

ModbusCmd.Title: Set ID Outside Temperature
ModbusCmd.HintText: If you want to read PDU Adress 5 "Outside temperature" - It´s necessary to send a "33284" for example with a "Constant block" to the Datapoint 6001.

ModbusCmd.Title: Set ID Compressor Frequency
ModbusCmd.HintText: If you want to read PDU Adress 4 "Compressor Frequency" - It´s necessary to send a " 33336 " for example with a "Constant block" to the Datapoint 6000.

ModbusCmd.Title: Set Target Supply Flow temperature HC2
ModbusCmd.HintText: Heating= 15°C to 65°C Cooling= 5°C to 25°C (attention for dew point!)

ModbusCmd.Title: Set Target Room temperature HC2
ModbusCmd.HintText: Heating= +16°C to 30°C Cooling= 18°C to 30°C

ModbusCmd.Title: Set ID Operation HC2
ModbusCmd.HintText: If you want to read or write PDU Adress 82 "Operation HC2" - It´s necessary to send a "16670" for example with a "Constant block" to the Datapoint 7000.

ModbusCmd.Title: Set ID Target Supply Flow temperature HC2
ModbusCmd.HintText: If you want to read or write PDU Adress 83 "Target Supply Flow temperature HC2" - It´s necessary to send a "17111" for example with a "Constant block" to the Datapoint 7001.

ModbusCmd.Title: Set ID Target Room temperature HC2
ModbusCmd.HintText: If you want to read or write PDU Adress 84 "Target room temperature HC2" - It´s necessary to send a "17110" for example with a "Constant block" to the Datapoint 7002.

ModbusCmd.Title: Set ID Additional Heater Hot Water
ModbusCmd.HintText: If you want to read or write PDU Adress "85" "Additional Heater Hot Water" - It´s necessary to send a "16519" for example with a "Constant block" to the Datapoint 7003.

ModbusCmd.Title: Set ID Additional Heater Heat/Cool Buffer
ModbusCmd.HintText: If you want to read or write PDU Adress "Additional Heater" "86" - It´s necessary to send a "16492" for example with a "Constant block" to the Datapoint 7004.

ModbusCmd.Title: Set ID Flow Rate
ModbusCmd.HintText: If you want to read or write PDU Adress "87" "Flow Rate" - It´s necessary to send a "17129" for example with a "Constant block" to the Datapoint 7005.

ModbusCmd.Title: Set ID Switching Valve
ModbusCmd.HintText: If you want to read or write PDU Adress "89" "Switching Valve" - It´s necessary to send a "16487" for example with a "Constant block" to the Datapoint 7007.
